summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of the Reschedule flow for OnCall Foot marketplace. Tested 10 scenarios covering eligibility display, modal interactions, slot selection, accessibility, happy-path mutation, and post-reschedule state. All core functionality working correctly.

accessibility_notes.issue: The role='dialog' and aria-modal='true' attributes are correctly implemented on the inner dialog div (line 185-188 of reschedule-modal.tsx), but the test queried the outer backdrop div with data-testid. This is correct HTML structure - the backdrop should not have dialog role. No fix needed.

passed_tests: TEST 1: Reschedule section and button visible on confirmed booking #41, along with Cancel and View Provider Profile buttons
TEST 2: NO reschedule section shown on requested booking #43 (correct eligibility logic)
TEST 3: Modal opens, displays current appointment time 'Currently Mon, Oct 12, 11:00 a.m.', date input works, slot grid loads with time buttons
TEST 4: Current appointment slot (2026-10-12T15:00:00.000Z / 11:00 AM) is disabled and shows 'current' label
TEST 5: Occupied slot (2026-10-12T16:00:00.000Z / 12:00 PM) held by another client is disabled
TEST 6: Submit button is disabled before any slot is selected

TEST 7: Happy path - selected slot 17:00:00Z (1:00 PM), submit button enabled, submission successful, success toast 'New time requested — your provider will confirm the change.', modal closed, booking status changed to 'Rescheduled'
TEST 8: After reschedule, booking #41 no longer shows reschedule section (status is 'rescheduled'), Cancel booking button still available
TEST 9: Escape key closes modal, close button has aria-label 'Close reschedule dialog'
TEST 10: Skipped gracefully - no completed bookings available to test Book Again section (as instructed)
